body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sisvel Group, a world leader in the protection and management of intellectual property rights, presented some of its most successful patent licensing programs during CES 2009, which include those related to the MPEG Audio standard, Layer I, Layer II and Layer III (MP3), to ATSS (Automatic Tuning & Sorting System), and WSS (which allows TV sets to change image formats automatically.)
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
